summary: Measured the frozen r4 artifacts and code without edits or live actions. Power panel bbox is 472x176 device px vs reference 537x200 (aspect 2.682 vs 2.685); fill median is RGB(0,0,0), disc centres/pitch match DISC_CX_FRACS, and uptime/label offsets are within about 2% of panel height after scale normalization. The orange centre disc (RGB 230,152,117) is the intentional Everforest accent, not a fidelity failure. Launcher bbox is 756x548 vs expected 756x549; search/row geometry is on spec, the first six rows blit native 36x36 device-scale app icons, and icon-box corners equal the surrounding row background (selected 25,26,31; unselected 2,2,2), so there are no square holes. One minor visual inconsistency remains: the launcher selection bar stays reference blue while other shell accents follow the selected theme.

findings.title: Launcher selection accent ignores selected theme
findings.detail: Measured launcher selected-row accent bar is RGB(121,161,245) while the power panel's themed centre disc is RGB(230,152,117). src/launcher_panel.rs:197 defines C_ACCENT as a fixed reference periwinkle and src/launcher_panel.rs:1299-1311 draws that constant directly; by contrast src/power_panel.rs:536 and src/controlcenter_panel.rs:334 read library::theme_accent(). Under the currently selected orange palette this leaves one 3 px shell accent visually stale. Fix by sourcing the launcher bar from library::theme_accent() with DEFAULT_ACCENT only when no theme is selected.

what_would_make_it_a_10: Theme the launcher selection bar from library::theme_accent() (keeping the reference accent as fallback), then re-capture the launcher screenshot and confirm its bar colour matches the power/control-centre accent under Everforest.
